description: Set one environment variable on the linked Rebase Cloud project (`rebase cloud env set KEY --stdin`). The value is written through stdin, never put on a command line, and never returned; `secret: true` makes it write-only. It applies on the next deploy.

preview.description: Set it for the project's previews only; production keeps its value

secret.description: Write-only: it can be replaced and used, never read back

name: rebase_cloud_env_set
